summary: Iteration 1 complete e2e testing of FormForge Formula engine + 13-source Data tab + lookups on the public Site Ops Demo form. 18/18 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend e2e: public form loads all 3 sites, lookup auto-fills (Alpha->AST-1001/Alpha/50/65), formulas recompute (DC/AC=1.3, Manager; Charlie->Vendor 1.28), submit returns 'Submission received'. Builder UI loads Properties panel with all 6 tabs (General, Data, Lookup, Formula, Validation, Adv) and Formula tab shows 'Enable Formula' toggle.

minor.issue: Engine REQUIRES double-curly {{field}} syntax; review_request listed single-curly {dc}/{ac} as the input but engine returns INVALID_FORMULA for single braces. All seeded form expressions correctly use {{field}} so end-to-end works. Consider whether to accept {field} as an alias OR clarify the doc/test expectation.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Decide on single-curly vs double-curly field token syntax. Either update docs/test spec to clarify {{field}} is the only supported syntax, or extend the tokenizer in /app/backend/formula_engine.py to also accept {field} as a field reference.
No other action items — all 14 review-request test points pass end-to-end (with the single-brace caveat noted above).
critical_code_review_comments: formula_engine.py is well-structured (~510 lines). Tokenizer regex only captures \{\{field\}\} — single braces are silently rejected.

datasource_routes.py rest_api branch uses synchronous `requests.get` inside an async route handler — will block the event loop. Should use httpx.AsyncClient for production-grade non-blocking behavior.

datasource_routes._resolve() requires authentication for *all* types including inline manual/json/csv. That is fine for the builder (which is authed), but the public form must use a separate public path (it already does — vendor_routes /api/public/lookup/resolve).
datasource_routes.py SQL branch correctly returns 501 — good defensive coding.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI flows verified, builder + public form)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 acceptance tests in the review request are verified passing end-to-end. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_formforge_features.py is the regression suite. The only behavioural caveat is field-token syntax: formula_engine.py REQUIRES double-curly {{field}}; the seeded form uses double-curly and works. If the next iteration changes the engine to also accept single braces, update test_validate_single_brace_should_work_per_request accordingly.
rca of the issue: No bug — the review_request's single-brace {dc}/{ac} example is a documentation mismatch with the actual engine syntax. Production form uses double-brace and works perfectly.
